findings.findingDescription: Leaky abstraction: Endpoint 'addtask' accepts and returns internal database entity 'Task' without DTO encapsulation
findings.groundTruthEvidence: Task is an annotated JPA database persistence entity (@Entity in Task.java). TaskController endpoints (addtask line 19, getTasks line 24, updateTask line 29) directly consume and return Task without DTO or record mapping. This violates CWE-497 (leaky abstraction) and exposes the application to mass-assignment over-posting on entity field 'id'. SentinelPR's ArchitectureReviewEngine missed this finding because its isEntityType heuristic only checks if the simple class name ends with 'Entity' or imports persistence.Entity locally, failing to resolve the cross-file AST declaration of Task.
findings.reviewerNotes: Engine defect in ArchitectureReviewEngine.isEntityType(): lacks cross-file symbol resolution to detect @Entity on referenced types.

findings.findingDescription: Fail-open security evaluation on TaskService exception handling
findings.evidence: Task task = taskRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("task not found"));
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No try-catch blocks exist in the codebase. Optional unwrapping uses orElseThrow(), which propagates RuntimeException/NoSuchElementException rather than swallowing exceptions and granting unauthorized access. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: I/O stream lifecycle evaluation across repository
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No unmanaged I/O streams or file descriptors (FileInputStream, FileOutputStream, etc.) are opened in the repository. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Concurrency and volatile field inspection across entities and services
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No volatile field declarations or compound mutations on volatile fields exist in the repository. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Subprocess execution inspection across business logic
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No ProcessBuilder or Runtime.exec invocations exist in the repository. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: SQL injection vulnerability inspection on database access layer
findings.evidence: public interface TaskRepo extends JpaRepository<Task, Long>
findings.groundTruthEvidence: All database operations are mediated entirely through Spring Data JpaRepository methods (save, findAll, findById, delete) with parameterized query binding. No raw SQL queries, EntityManager createQuery string concatenations, or unparameterized queries exist. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Path traversal inspection on controller endpoints
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No File, Path, or filesystem operations accept user input or parameters in the repository. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Deserialization inspection on REST payload ingress
findings.groundTruthEvidence: REST payloads are parsed via standard Spring Web Jackson JSON deserializer. No native Java ObjectInputStream.readObject() calls exist. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Hardcoded secret inspection across source code and properties
findings.groundTruthEvidence: No API keys, private tokens, passwords, or cloud credentials are embedded in Java source files. application.properties configures an empty datasource password. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: CSRF protection inspection on Spring Security configuration
findings.groundTruthEvidence: Spring Security is not present in pom.xml and no SecurityFilterChain bean disables CSRF. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Permissive CORS origin inspection on REST controller
findings.groundTruthEvidence: The @CrossOrigin annotation restricts allowed origins to 'http://localhost:63342' (local IDE preview port). It does not use wildcard '*' origin. FrameworkContextAnalyzer correctly identified this as non-permissive under CWE-942. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Architectural cycle evaluation across package graph
findings.groundTruthEvidence: Package dependencies form a strict directed acyclic graph: controller -> service -> repository -> entity. No circular dependencies exist. Evaluated safe.

findings.findingDescription: Non-deterministic system call inspection in service layer
findings.groundTruthEvidence: TaskService contains no invocations of System.currentTimeMillis, System.nanoTime, Math.random, or Random instantiations. Evaluated safe.

notes: Validation conducted as part of SentinelPR Phase 4A.2 real-repository evaluation.
Repository cloned to isolated scratch directory outside SentinelPR workspace.
Static AST and dataflow inspection completed without runtime code execution or database connection.
Zero production findings detected by engine; human ground-truth audit confirmed 12 True Negatives across security and architectural rules.
Engine identified 1 False Negative (ARCH-002) due to single-file naming heuristic in ArchitectureReviewEngine.isEntityType(), which failed to resolve @Entity across files for entity class 'Task'.
